note: Sample strings of the multilingual export suite (README.md). Edit the text here, then run build.mjs to rebuild the fixtures and codepoints (build.mjs --check verifies them). expect.pdf per host: text = every non-emoji character extractable from the PDF; image = drawn as an image; outline = drawn as glyph outlines (not extractable); a list allows either. verified: whether a run on that host has confirmed it.

samples.source: constructed for this suite (common words, no copyrighted text) (four Han characters from CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B, U+2070E, U+20731, U+20779, U+20C53)
samples.look: four Han characters, none a tofu box

why.web: Han without kana asks for Noto Sans SC unless the browser language is zh-TW/HK/Hant (scriptFontKey, lekhjs web-script-font-provider.ts); the SC subset has none of these four Ext B characters (Noto Sans TC has all four) and the provider offers no second CJK face, so the run is drawn as an image with the toast.
why.ios: Whether the system CJK face getFontData picks covers these Ext B characters is not known before the first native run; with no cover the run is an image (and the toast).
why.mac: Whether the system CJK face getFontData picks covers these Ext B characters is not known before the first native run; with no cover the run is an image (and the toast).
why.android: Whether the system CJK face getFontData picks covers these Ext B characters is not known before the first native run; with no cover the run is an image (and the toast).

Which scripts depends on the device fonts; the native run records it.
